I'm a graduate student in the MS in Applied Business Analytics program at Boston University's Metropolitan College. Originally from Kazakhstan, I come to analytics from a background in international and comparative politics, where I learned to ask good questions about institutions, economies, and people. Now I'm building the technical toolkit to answer them with data: Python, SQL, PySpark, and cloud platforms like AWS.
